mandate: C434 — test the price-only LARGEST LYAPUNOV EXPONENT dynamical-systems chaos stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0); m[t]=mean_i r_i[t] (equal-weight market return). Causal trailing mean mu[t] and std sigma[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128). Standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-mu[t])/sigma[t] (z[t]=0 if sigma[t]<=0 or non-finite). Per trailing window of z: build a delay embedding E (m x tau, tau=1) for m in {3,4,5,6}; largest Lyapunov exponent = slope of mean log-divergence L[k]=mean_i ln(||Y[i+k]-Y[j(i)+k]||/||Y[i]-Y[j(i)]||) on k=1..K (K=8), where j(i) is the nearest neighbor of trajectory point i with |i-j|>Theiler window=1. lyap_m3, lyap_m4, lyap_m5, lyap_m6. NaN if t<W_q or any NaN/non-finite in window or sigma[t]<=0. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (lyap_m3_dev, lyap_m4_dev, lyap_m5_dev, lyap_m6_dev) + 4 placebos (i.i.d. permutation seed 20261298 of the standardized returns, same marginal, destroyed serial geometry). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W_q or sigma[t]<=0 or NaN in trailing window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; sign=sign(log_return) (+1/-1/0, sign[0]=0).
methodology.primitives: causal trailing mean/std mu[t], sigma[t] of {r[t-W_q+1..t]}, W_q=256 (fallback 128); standardized return z[t]=(r[t]-mu[t])/sigma[t]; delay embedding E (m x tau, tau=1) for m in {3,4,5,6}; largest Lyapunov exponent = slope of mean log-divergence L[k] on k=1..K (K=8) over nearest-neighbor trajectory pairs with Theiler window=1; lyap_m3, lyap_m4, lyap_m5, lyap_m6.
methodology.signals: lyap_m3_dev/lyap_m4_dev/lyap_m5_dev/lyap_m6_dev plus i.i.d.-permutation-surrogate placebos over W_q=256 (seed 20261298); score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: i.i.d. permutation (seed 20261298) of the standardized returns z before the Lyapunov pipeline; same marginal distribution, destroyed serial geometry; deterministic seed recorded; never market data, never fabricated.
methodology.lyap_vectorization_note: rolling mean/std via cumulative sums O(N); sliding trailing windows of z; delay embedding via sliding_window_view; chunked pairwise nearest-neighbor distance matrix; divergence accumulation over horizon K; linear-regression slope of mean log-divergence on k. Validated against a naive per-window O(W^2) all-pairs nearest-neighbor Lyapunov reference with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
